Terry — thanks for sending this over and for the clear summary.

Quick note on process: our procurement ops team needs (minimum) the following to create a vendor master and route the first PO:
- Legal entity name exactly as it appears on tax docs
- Corporate registered address and remit-to address (if different)
- Tax ID (EIN) + signed W-9 (for US entities)
- Primary AP contact (name + email + phone)
- Banking confirmation letter (for ACH setup)
- W-9 or equivalent executed form (we can accept DocuSign)

We do not strictly require a DUNS number for vendor creation, but if you have one please include it (helps with payments mapping).

I attached our vendor intake spreadsheet to capture canonical values (Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx). If you fill that and return, Karthik and Marissa will validate tax/classification and finish the ERP setup. Estimated turnaround after complete docs: 3-5 business days.

Next steps:
1) Please complete the attached intake form and attach W-9 + bank letter.
2) Confirm remittance email and preferred PO acknowledgement flow.
3) If there are any special payment terms (net30 vs negotiated), flag them now so Finance can mark the account.

If you prefer, we can start a DocuSign for the W-9.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
